description: Lvc() in 2.1.228 determines the telemetry-network policy ('essential-traffic'/'no-telemetry'/'default') from env vars. Hard-code it to return 'no-telemetry' so telemetry/analytics traffic is blocked by default without needing CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC / DISABLE_TELEMETRY / DO_NOT_TRACK env vars. Ha()/FLe() consumers then behave as if telemetry is disabled.

patches.description: traffic-policy function -> no-telemetry by default (name-agnostic, whole function shape)

note: Env default-reader JS body absent from active region. Renaming CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC would break legitimate user opt-in.
